data_description.implementation: The RHYMAX Cloud connection used to sign in to your RHYMAX account.

auth.title: Sign in to RHYMAX
auth.description: Sign in with your RHYMAX account on the page that opens. Once you allow access, you return to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to RHYMAX again
reauth_confirm.description: The link between Home Assistant and your RHYMAX account has expired. Sign in again to keep controlling your mowers.

abort.already_configured: This RHYMAX account is already linked.
abort.reauth_successful: Your RHYMAX account is linked again.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with a different RHYMAX account. Sign in with the account that was linked before.
abort.link_rejected: RHYMAX Cloud did not accept the account link. Home Assistant linking may not be enabled yet; please try again later.
abort.linking_unavailable: Home Assistant linking is not available yet. Please try again later.
abort.invalid_auth: RHYMAX Cloud did not accept the sign-in. Please try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to RHYMAX Cloud. Please try again later.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing the sign-in page.
abort.missing_configuration: Rhymax Mower is not set up correctly. Please check your Home Assistant My integration configuration.
abort.missing_credentials: Account linking configuration is unavailable. Please update Rhymax Mower and try again.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. For information about this error, [check the help section]({docs_url}).
abort.oauth_error: RHYMAX Cloud returned invalid sign-in data.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not complete sign-in with RHYMAX Cloud. Please try again later.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while completing sign-in with RHYMAX Cloud.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: RHYMAX Cloud did not accept the sign-in.

auth_failed.message: The link to your RHYMAX account has expired. Sign in again to continue.

credentials_missing.message: The link to your RHYMAX account needs to be renewed. Sign in again to continue.

relink_required.message: This entry is not linked to a RHYMAX account. Delete it and add Rhymax Mower again.

linking_unavailable.message: Home Assistant linking is not available yet. Please try again later.

update_failed.message: Could not get the mower status from RHYMAX Cloud: {error}

cannot_connect.message: Could not connect to RHYMAX Cloud. Please try again later.

command_failed.message: RHYMAX Cloud could not send the command. Please try again later.

command_rejected.message: The mower could not carry out the command.

mower_busy.message: The mower is busy with another command. Please try again in a moment.

mower_timeout.message: The mower did not respond in time. It may still carry out the command, so check its status before trying again.

mower_not_found.message: This mower is no longer on your RHYMAX account.

region_restricted.message: Cloud control is not available for this mower in its current region.
